children: Polymarket’s submarket for the Argentina vs. Burkina Faso event saw the probability of the “Over” option in the first-half total of 4.5 fall sharply from 47% one hour earlier to 24.5%, a 22.5% swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move was monitored by Catcher Predict and may reflect the impact of related breaking news.

title: Polymarket Submarket Odds Swing Sharply on Argentina vs. Burkina Faso Event
